searches.note: Eighteen searches of twenty eight, ten unspent. Most searches blocked the author's domains so the second source would be independent; six were held to a house's own domain to read its sheets. No WebFetch was tried.

method: Each record was read with one instruction, refute it: founding, people and dates, grapes, sites, making, label words, every beat of the story, the cards and the questions; then the house rules.
Where a search contradicted the record it was set right with its source; where a detail stood in one source or none it was cut or hedged.

tested: Purchase of 1975, vines of 1976, the son's takeover of 1991 and purchase of 1994 (Wine with Seth, Wine Anorak, the Bouchard Finlayson timeline read in search): sound; the founder's trade now plain.
The 1976 cellar (Bouchard Finlayson's own timeline; a profile giving its winemaker's arrival in 1979): hedged.
Grand Vin Noir 1981 (Decanter review of the 1983 Grand Vin Noir, Falstaff, Vinous): sound; the vines four or five years old, so young vines.
Making (the house's sheets for 2009, 2010, 2015 and 2017 on hamiltonrussellvineyards.com): 228 litre French oak, ten months, malolactic in full; new oak 37 to 45 per cent. Changed.
The founder's death (Wine Spectator, HCI, July 2013): dead, no year of birth found; the 1982 Chardonnay, Southern Right 1994 and Ashbourne 1996 (Decanter, a tasting note).

dead: Tim Hamilton Russell, the founder, died July 2013 aged 79 (Wine Spectator, HCI); year of birth not found, so he is described, not named.
swapRulings: No swap proposed by the author; none made. Each pick is the wine its house leads with by its own pages.
codexTension: The library record p-hamilton-russell names founder and son in holdings and calls the Pinot 'South Africa's benchmark Pinot'; the founder is dead (2013), the son living, and benchmark is a ranking word. Reported, not edited.

The region summary says Newton Johnson and others followed; nothing in tension beyond that. The library's Bokkeveld shale for Hamilton Russell is the library's word; the house's sheets say shale derived only.
questionsChecked: Ten questions read: each has one right answer and four options of one kind. Creation's story question replaced, since its key (Grenache in 2003 as a first) was unsourced. Bouchard Finlayson's story explanation hedged on the 1976 cellar.
